encode_audio_latents: encode audio spectrograms into latent representations using AutoencoderKLLTX2Audio encode method
decode_audio_latents: decode audio latent representations back to spectrograms using AutoencoderKLLTX2Audio decode method
build_causal_conv2d: build a LTX2AudioCausalConv2d layer with asymmetric padding along a specified causality axis
create_pixel_norm: create a LTX2AudioPixelNorm per-pixel RMS normalization layer for audio VAE feature maps
run_autoencoder_forward: run the full AutoencoderKLLTX2Audio forward pass to encode and decode audio spectrograms
